# World Brief — Monday, 12 October 2026

**In one line:** India's inflation jumped to a 23-month high while the rupee rebounded sharply on RBI intervention, as Middle East tensions pushed crude above $105.

## 🚨 Top 5 things to know
- ✅ CONFIRMED **NEW** — **India retail inflation surges to 5.54% in September**
  *What happened:* India's Consumer Price Index inflation jumped to **5.54% in September** from 4.8% in August, driven by a sharp rise in food prices like onions and garlic. *Why it matters:* This 23-month high makes an early **RBI interest rate cut** very unlikely. ## 🇮🇳 India
- **Retail inflation accelerated to 5.54%** in September from 4.8% in August, hitting a **23-month high** [[Reuters]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxQdUxxMHVta3BKU2dCLTBRTU5iRm1Xd1gwWWNBTzI4djlyVmFnYWpyZzRJbFQtamt5WHVoaFhCd1lMLVRWMUxpaGw5WERwT3dWZGJvbmRxYjhVUE5pU1Y4NjRzX2lVN1BpXzlBckQxMW4tYmhkNnpKOVQtdUQwSFJKUUZHUThxbnNRYllBZGtGSTV3MXFWZkc4cjRVUHJyU2c2MkNiRWczUl9NTUpVQ2tiSFVjR090Wk9yNjU3NkR4ZklId2o1akswcXNhZ3ptdw?oc=5) [[The Hindu]](https://www.thehindu.com/business/Economy/retail-inflation-rises-in-september-on-costlier-food-items/article71574789.ece). The spike was led by food costs, with **onion prices doubling** alongside steep increases in ginger and garlic [[NDTV Profit]](https://news.google.?oc=5). The jump reduces room for the Reserve Bank of India to ease borrowing costs soon.
- **Mutual fund equity inflows surged 31%** to **₹38,307 crore** in September, while systematic investment plan (SIP) contributions reached a record **₹32,490 crore** [[Cafemutual]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQVVc4Y1FiSklXQVNfbF9uZWFmcGYtUmhLc2lRR0diWjM0UDExSUJLYmtoTXR3RXVvejRBYzFIRkV3TF96QXZnOGtobk82QzBZVDAyV1V4YzdkSmFTLXdwWEU4Umo0QzdBcmt0RF92ZUthWWNyR3lmeXZzNkJYXzZlRnlUZmRkNnpzUHVIbnRFX2FVN1hQZ2tGUXZxbENnVmJQa2ZabTZ2ck1mZzk1VFBUS1IzUHQ3X2huQ29vTml4UQ?oc=5) [[The Statesman]](https://news.google.?oc=5). Domestic retail investors continued pouring money into equities despite global market headwinds.
- **The Supreme Court pushed price caps on cancer drugs**, prompting the central government to move toward capping trade margins at **30% for oncology medicines** [[Live Law]](https://news.google.?oc=5). The court also questioned excessive markups across other life-saving pharmaceuticals.
- **Opposition leaders marched to the Supreme Court** to protest against the Election Commission over voter roll revision procedures [[BBC]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwr5y2lgr4gdo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) [[Live Law]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- **Telangana & Hyderabad:** The victim killed in the recent Riyadh airport drone strike was confirmed to be a **Hyderabad resident on an Umrah pilgrimage** [[Rediff]](https://news.google.?oc=5). Meanwhile, the Telangana government urged farmers across districts to **conserve irrigation water** amid El Niño concerns [[ThePrint]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

  *Agency involved:* US Department of Justice / Department of Homeland Security.
  *What happened:* Government attorneys filed an appeal against a federal court injunction that blocked an emergency rule imposing a **$100,000 fee on H-1B petitions** [[Bloomberg Law News]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPcmtlLW9VeGk3M0NtdjlpcDEtMkNJWkc2UkNDeERHNEtQaTh4X1dDWmgxSHBJY0RjZGJPOGp1R3UtS3c3OTB1aWsxY25oUVRCa3AxTHBad1BfUnctcTJ5WWNZbVNXT3FoazJzNE5lSm5XOFV2NDZXRG9HT2RVVWhxa3RSOXI2dG12cFR5WnM1RW9IU3dWUHhXbTByaWxVUWk2NWZUbml1ZGFGTG13czJ6Yk1R?oc=5).

- 🟡 DEVELOPING **PERM labor certifications drop sharply across top IT consultancies**
  *Agency involved:* US Department of Labor.
  *What happened:* Data showed permanent labor certifications (PERM) for 13 major IT service firms fell to **607 filings over nine months**, down from 1,670 in the previous fiscal year [[Times of India]](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/perm-certifications-at-13-it-companies-fell-to-607-in-9-months-from-1670-in-fy25/articleshow/134902149.cms).
  *Status impact:* Indicates slower employment-based green card processing queues for tech contractors, though individual visa validity is unaffected.
- 🔵 PROPOSAL / DISCUSSION **Indian Commerce Minister downplays overseas visa reliance**
  *What happened:* Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that reduced overseas H-1B grants retain premier technical talent to build domestic Indian capacity [[News18]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

- 💻 **Tech career:** Microsoft and AMD are expanding in-house AI chips and agent infrastructure, creating high demand for engineers skilled in diverse hardware runtimes.
- 💰 **Money:** A stronger rupee (₹95.75) means slightly fewer rupees per dollar sent home; domestic Indian mutual fund SIP flows remain at all-time highs.
- 🛂 **Immigration:** The $100k H-1B fee rule remains blocked while under appeal, though PERM processing slowdowns require long-term green card contingency planning.

## 📜 On this day
- **12 October 1928:** The iron lung medical ventilator was used for the first time at Boston Children's Hospital to treat a child paralyzed by polio.
- **12 October 1892:** The Pledge of Allegiance was first recited in US public schools to mark the World's Columbian Exposition.
